cs.t: I like this because I keep a U2F Neo-n device permanently in my laptop USB port. It's just more convenient for services that support it. In the future, I would like to require it for employees on our app. However, when I go into Github to turn it on (in chrome using U2F devices I have already used with Google) it says "This device cannot be registered." Even when I remove the device it says that. I'm disappointed that the feature is not working.
